sample.question:
In Skybridge 3D, each tower top shows its height. What is the correct height order of beacons A, B, and C from lowest to highest? Use '=' for ties.
Options:
[1] B < A < C
[2] A < B < C
[3] B = C < A
[4] A < C < B
[5] C < B < A
[6] C < A < B
[7] B < C < A
sample.analysis: Beacon heights are A=4, B=3, C=3. Sorting these heights gives B = C < A. Therefore choose option 3.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.
